g.text: Fixed permanent-magnet flux, steady operation, no friction loss, V=24 V,R_a=2 Ω,k_e=k_t=0.10 in SI units. Electrical inductance matters during transients.
A tachogenerator converts mechanical speed to signed voltage; terminal polarity depends on direction of rotation and wiring.
